verdict.rationale: Cactus documents a public REST API for its platform: POST /generations, POST /tool_schemas, a reserve/PUT/complete upload flow, GET /billing and GET /v1/plans. The docs point to an OpenAPI spec at /v1/openapi.json and an llms.txt (confirmed live by probe) that names coding agents with an API key as a supported way to run it. Separately, the open-source engine exposes OpenAI-compatible APIs with multi-language bindings, and a community user calls the API very simple. The probe's 404s were only at root-level OpenAPI paths, not the documented /v1 path, so they do not contradict the docs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the hosted REST API and its OpenAPI spec, clear documentation of authentication and key handling; community also flags the SDK's inline model download as awkward.
